title: Customer, service and request: verify your service desk relationships
goal: Trace a real request to its catalog items and show that renaming a customer does not create a new identity.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 4; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: An entity follows its lifecycle
paragraphs: A customer exists before and after individual requests; a service describes an offering; a request records an occurrence in time. Repeating customer text in each request creates duplicates and widespread edits after a name change. A catalog reference separates persistent identity from recurring operations.

Use customer Учебный A5, service Диагностика A5 and two requests of 30 and 15 minutes. Create the customer once and select the same item in both documents. The customer ← requests → service diagram shows stored reference direction, not window order: each request contains both references.

sections.title: One customer, two requests
paragraphs: This is a data diagram, not executable BSL. Use Enterprise cards.

code.source:
C1 ← R1: 30 minutes → S1
C1 ← R2: 15 minutes → S1
Own-set control: 30 + 15 = 45
code.output: Two distinct requests retain the same customer/service references and total 45 minutes.

sections.title: Minimal fields must still be sufficient
paragraphs: The teaching core needs customer and service codes/names plus a document with references, date, minutes and status. Real phone numbers, addresses and identity documents are unnecessary. Associate each field with a workflow and persistence criterion; otherwise the model grows without testable benefit.

The platform assigns the item code when it is saved. Record actual codes and document numbers; C1, S1 and R1 are diagram labels only. A name is human-readable and may coincide between different records. Do not type C1 into a numeric code or rename metadata merely to match an illustration.

sections.title: A rule connects objects
paragraphs: A request selects an existing customer and service; an enumeration supplies allowed statuses. Deleting a referenced customer is not an isolated list cleanup. Specify inactive-customer and historical-document behavior. The foundation course can use marking and reference checks without claiming an industrial archival mechanism.

Rename only your Учебный A5 item to Учебный A5 — уточнено. Save it, reopen both requests and open their linked customer. The actual code should remain unchanged. If you made a duplicate, inspect which item each request references; do not bulk-replace links or delete records to improve the appearance of a report.

sections.title: Equal names conceal separate items
paragraphs: Opening each card and comparing codes detects what the displayed name conceals.

code.source:
C1 Учебный A5 and C2 Учебный A5
R1.Customer = C1; R2.Customer = C2
code.output: The names coincide but the references differ; this is not two requests for one customer.

sections.title: A workflow checks cohesion
paragraphs: Follow createcustomer → createservice → createrequest → findrequest → obtaintotal. Record identity and successful reread at each step. Change the customer’s displayed name and confirm the request still references the same item. This tests model cohesion rather than merely collecting attractive screens.

Record actual document number, customer code, service code, duration, status and successful reopening. Your two-request control is 45 minutes. The entire infobase can contain more minutes from earlier lessons. Compare the same bounded set and retain those records: this begins an acceptance scenario, not evidence of a production system.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: A new equal-named customer is created for each request. Select your existing item and compare its actual code.
The entire-base total is used as the two-request control. Compare the same documents and independently calculate 30+15.
The C1/R1 diagram is pasted as executable BSL. It explains relationships; perform this lesson in Enterprise cards.

selfcheck.prompt: Another request for the same customer needs
selfcheck.feedback: The requests differ; their customer is shared.

selfcheck.prompt: How do you distinguish equal names?
options: Open the cards and compare codes/references
selfcheck.feedback: Position and name do not establish identity.

selfcheck.prompt: Explain why equal names do not prove equal references and why the current name is not a historical snapshot.
selfcheck.feedback: Identity and history have distinct checks; no bulk cleanup.

practice.title: Two requests share one customer after a rename
practice.task: Explain why equal names do not prove equal references and why the current name is not a historical snapshot.
practice.environment: Official local training platform; original service-desk configuration, synthetic records only. Studio and Sandbox optional.
practice.externalRoute: Installed 1C Enterprise / Designer of your separate training copy

steps.title: Open the continuing copy
steps.action: Choose your module 4 copy and verify its name and directory against your notes. Open Учебная служба. Do not load a full CF over your work.
steps.why: Continue preserved work rather than replace it with a template.
steps.expected: Earlier customers, services and requests are visible.
steps.troubleshooting: If these lists are absent, return to module 2 preparation; a new empty base is not your earlier work.
steps.before: Your module 4 work and copy provenance are retained; actual infobase path identified.

steps.title: Prepare the two cards
steps.where: Enterprise → Учебная служба → Клиенты, then Услуги
steps.action: Create Учебный A5 and Диагностика A5 only if absent from your own attempt. Use Записать и закрыть, reopen and record the assigned codes.
steps.why: Reusing your attempt avoids silent duplicates.
steps.expected: One identified customer and service exist.
steps.troubleshooting: For equal names, compare actual card codes without deleting older records.
steps.before: Earlier customers, services and requests are visible.

steps.title: Save two requests
steps.action: Select these items, 30 minutes and Новая in the first request; save and close. Save the second with the same items and 15 minutes. Record actual numbers and dates.
steps.why: Distinguish another request from another customer.
steps.expected: Two saved requests with a 45-minute own-set control.
steps.troubleshooting: Correct the reported invalid field while keeping other input; retain validation.
steps.before: One identified customer and service exist.

steps.title: Rename the same customer
steps.action: Change its name to Учебный A5 — уточнено and save. Do not use Create; verify the same code.
steps.why: A display change must not replace identity.
steps.troubleshooting: If you edited a duplicate, inspect the original code and links without deleting records.
steps.before: Two saved requests with a 45-minute own-set control.

steps.title: Verify both references
steps.action: Reopen each request, open the linked customer using the button beside its field and compare the code. Check duration and service, then fill your observation table.
steps.expected: Same customer and service, distinct 30/15-minute requests.
steps.troubleshooting: An entire-base report may exceed 45; isolate your set by customer/numbers without clearing data.

criteria: The request stores the references; customer identity is not repeated name text.
Actual codes/numbers retained, 30+15=45 and earlier records intact.
Identity and history have distinct checks; no bulk cleanup.
Actual infobase/version, own synthetic codes and numbers, before/after field observations.
Saved source and outcome; any missing or untested behavior explicitly recorded.
Use the second worked case only in an own copy or unsaved draft. Preserve the accepted record and explain the discrepancy.
